notes.title: The Ghost Keeper Steam page is now LIVE 👻
notes.content:
[h2]We proudly introduce Ghost Keeper, our joint project with Quest Craft & Gaming Factory 🤝[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Although our work on Gimle is in full swing, a part of our team enthusiastically backed the initiative of Quest Craft and Gaming Factory studios, resulting in today's exciting event. We are happy to announce that the Steam page of our joint project - [b]Ghost Keeper - is now LIVE! [/b]

You're probably wondering what Ghost Keeper actually is and why it deserves your attention 🤔 Making a long story short, the game is [b]an addictive scaring experience[/b] inspired by the genre's pioneer, Ghost Master. Thanks to Ghost Keeper, you will once again become the leader of a terrifying band of monsters and challenge the living.[b] Sounds terrifyingly good, right? [/b]

[h2]Marvel at the brand-new Announcement Teaser[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=LVfs-iHNUvw;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see, there are plenty of intriguing challenges ahead... and lots of great fun too! We can't wait to see how you fare in this humorous [b]scaring simulator[/b] 😱 A band of peculiar monsters awaits your orders, but there's more... much more! 

• [b]Fight the malicious Brotherhood[/b] - getting rid of its members and stealing their secrets is very dangerous... but comes with unimaginable rewards

• [b]Exploit varied strategies[/b] - there is never only one path to victory, all comes down to the choices you make

• [b]Enjoy a truly grotesque approach[/b] - witness a host of bizarre situations narrated by the peculiar, malicious narrator

• [b]Delve into the Victorian era[/b] - witness a setting, locations, style and atmosphere that’ll captivate you on each subsequent level

• [b]Take control[/b] - lead numerous ghosts, demons, and monsters, use their unique abilities to defeat your enemies


[h2]Add Ghost Keeper to your Steam Wishlist[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
You have proven to us many times what an amazing community you are, so we believe that you will show your great enthusiasm and keenness once again! That being said, there are several ways you can [b]support our latest project[/b] and [b]help us develop it[/b]. 

First of all, you can [b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/]add Ghost Keeper to your Steam Wishlist »[/url][/u][/b] and join its [b][u][url=https://discord.com/invite/cNS5gvvy7m]dedicated Discord Server »[/url][/u][/b] You can also follow Ghost Keeper Social Media channels where we will post the most interesting news and announcements about the game: [b][u][url=https://x.com/GhostKeeperGame]Twitter / X »[/url][/u][/b], [b][u][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@ghostkeepergame]TikTok »[/url][/u][/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/775a50996b5f59e1c492249fd11db77b1e187a62.png[/img]
[/url]
If you find [b]Ghost Keeper[/b] interesting (we hope you do! 🤩) and want to learn more about its content, features, mechanics and the general vibe, be sure to visit this [u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/]Steam page »[/url][/u]

[b]Thank you for your attention, everyone![/b] 🖐️
